trust_assumptions: Proxy initialization is atomic and uses nonzero authorized roles. Invalid configurations remain explicit test cases.
Primary collateral tests assume standard non-rebasing tokens and a vault with documented rounding. Hostile callback tests state separate assumptions.
External valuation, token supply and Transmuter graph behavior must be fixed in fixtures or composed with real contracts.
Symbolic input bounds and sequence limits constrain each claim. Successful-call assertions must remain reachable.
threats: Unauthorized debt mint or collateral withdrawal
Unbacked synthetics after redemption or collateral loss
Double-counted cover and stale epoch checkpoints
Rounding amplified across account sync and redemption
Router donation capture, allowance leakage and reentrant callbacks
limitations: Full production library assembly and Q128 products may require bounded subproofs and fuzz fallback.
Certora local stored-debt/collateral bounds may not hold before account sync. Reassess rather than import as assumptions.
